title: Distance from a constant function
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. If $f$ is not constant and its Fourier degree is at most $k$, then the fraction of inputs on which $f$ differs from any fixed constant sign $c\\in\\{-1,1\\}$ is at least $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
the Fourier degree of the real-valued sign embedding of $f$ is at most $k$
